title: Engineer - Design
description:
**India, Coimbatore**
---------------------

**Engineering and Manufacturing**
---------------------------------

The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for assisting in providing innovative and cost effective solutions requiring the development or sustaining of new or improved techniques, procedures or products. The Mechanical Engineer also assist in planning, conducting and evaluating approaches to meeting the project objectives in a timely fashion.

* Assist in identifying and organizing requirements. Apply relevant usability procedures and principles.
* Analyze, design, develop, maintain products and assist in their commercialization.
* Build prototypes, products and systems suitable for testing. Set up and run lab simulations. Design and implement tests, document results and develop customer presentations. Provide timely corrective actions on defects.
* Produce analyses and mathematical models and draw design conclusions based on those.
* Conduct or participate in technical reviews of requirements, specifications, designs, code and other artifacts. Contribute to design standards and support design re-use.
* Create and maintain product documentation. Provide support to field and customers through InTouch. Provide user training as required.
* Assign, direct and review work of technicians and provide guidance to engineers. With seniority, mentor junior engineers.
* Continually evaluate engineering approaches and risks.
* Author technical reports, papers, articles, patents and presentations. Share expertise via Eureka and special interest groups. Expand informal network throughout the organization.
* Keep abreast of novel technical concepts and markets. Adopt new practices readily to develop innovative and low-cost products.
* Maintain familiarity with company technology, organization and business.
* Comply with Sarbanes-Oxley requirements as defined in the risk control matrix.

2-4 years

SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: JUNIOR DESIGN ENGINEER - EEE
description:
Electrical & Automation Engineer (PLC / Controls)

**Company:** Brahma Design Tech Solutions  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an Electrical & Automation Engineer with practical knowledge of PLC programming, electrical design, industrial controls, and automation system integration. The candidate will contribute to the development, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of industrial automation machines and material handling systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, test, and troubleshoot PLC programs for automation and material handling systems.
* Prepare electrical schematics, panel layouts, and BOMs using EPLAN or AutoCAD Electrical.
* Select sensors, motors, drives, safety devices, and electrical components.
* Integrate robots, AMRs, conveyors, HMIs, and SCADA systems.
* Configure industrial networks such as PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and CAN.
* Configure servo drives, VFDs, safety PLCs, and safety relays.
* Perform or support installation, wiring verification, commissioning, and troubleshooting at customer sites.
* Prepare I/O lists, functional descriptions, test reports, manuals, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with mechanical and software engineering teams for project integration.

Required Skills

* PLC programming experience with Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi, or Delta.
* Knowledge of Ladder Logic, Structured Text, and Function Block programming.
* HMI development and configuration.
* Electrical panel design, wiring practices, and electrical drawings.
* Knowledge of sensors, encoders, servo systems, VFDs, and industrial communication protocols.
* Understanding of basic machine safety systems, including emergency stops, light curtains, and safety relays.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with ABB, KUKA, FANUC, or Universal Robots.
* Exposure to AS/RS, shuttle systems, and conveyor systems.
* Knowledge of SCADA.
* Basic Python or C++ for automation scripting.

Educational Qualification

B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Automation, or a relevant discipline.

Additional Requirements

* Willingness to travel for site installation and commissioning.
* Good communication and teamwork.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and meet deadlines.

Application Instructions

Interested candidates may submit their updated resume through the designated application channel.

**Company:** Brahma Design Tech Solutions

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Engineer - Cloud & Infra Services
description:
**Role description**

Job Title: Senior Engineer - Cloud & Infra Services  
Location: Coimbatore  
Experience: 3-5 years

We are urgently seeking a highly skilled Senior Engineer to join our Cloud & Infra Services team. This critical role demands immediate expertise in Azure Active Directory, M365, and Windows Server environments to drive essential infrastructure projects and support.

Job Description:  
1. Administer and support critical Microsoft 365 services, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.  
2. Manage and troubleshoot Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) for user provisioning, synchronization, and identity management.  
3. Provide expert support for Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, and authentication services.  
4. Develop and maintain robust PowerShell scripts for automation, reporting, and operational efficiency across cloud and on-premise infrastructure.  
5. Configure and troubleshoot essential security solutions, including MFA, DKIM, DMARC, and SPF, to protect our cloud services.  
6. Collaborate effectively with infrastructure, security, and project teams to deliver seamless cloud and infrastructure integration and migration initiatives.  
7. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.  
8. Participate actively in troubleshooting, issue resolution, and post-implementation support for cloud and infrastructure services.

Skills and Qualifications:  
Proven experience (3-5 years) in cloud and infrastructure engineering roles.  
Mandatory expertise in Azure Active Directory and M365 Suites of Products.  
Strong proficiency with Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.  
Demonstrated ability to develop and utilize PowerShell for automation.  
Solid understanding of networking, security, and identity management principles.  
Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to system health.

Why Join Us:  
This is an urgent opportunity to make an immediate impact within a fast-paced and dynamic environment. You will contribute directly to the stability and evolution of our critical cloud and infrastructure services.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Apply now to join our innovative team.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Job Type Permanant (Full Time)
* Work Experience 8-10 years
* City Coimbatore
* Country India

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Monitor network availability, performance, and reliability across enterprise environments.
* Provide Level-3 support for complex network incidents, changes, and problems.
* Configure, install, troubleshoot, and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless, and data center network components.
* Plan, design, and execute IT changes and network projects with proper documentation and governance.
* Perform trend analysis, identify potential network problems, and drive proactive remediation.
* Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and operational documentation.
* Ensure accurate incident, change, and problem records using standard ITSM processes.

  
  

### **Requirements**

* Strong understanding of OSI model, TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, LACP, RSTP, IGMP, QoS, and routing protocols including BGP.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, firewall, VPN, and data center network environments.
* Experience with Cisco Nexus/NX-OS, F5 Load Balancers, ASA, Juniper SRX, Palo Alto, and multi-vendor Wi-Fi platforms such as Cisco and Juniper Mist.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex network issues using monitoring tools and packet analysis tools such as Wireshark.
* Good knowledge of incident, change, and problem management practices.

Experience with F5 LTM, web application firewalls, RADIUS, IPVPN technologies such as GRE/IPsec, and network automation or scripting using Python and ansible.

* Knowledge of ITIL framework and relevant networking certifications will be an added advantage.
